aiSummary.overview: Cloud infrastructure audit reveals significant potential for monthly cost reduction through instance right-sizing, termination of idle resources, and implementation of lifecycle management policies for unattached storage. Total monthly savings potential is estimated at $694.
keyFindings: Multiple high-cost EC2 instances exhibit idle behavior with CPU utilization below 3%.
Several oversized compute instances in production and development are significantly under-utilizing memory and CPU capacity.
Unused S3 buckets generate unnecessary costs due to lack of recent read/write operations.
nextSteps: Terminate or stop identified idle instances to immediately eliminate wastage.
Downsize production and development EC2 instances based on observed performance metrics.
Implement automated S3 lifecycle policies for buckets showing no activity over the past 7 days.
